thread:
maria: Heads up — compliance asked for a one-click export of 'who changed routing policies' but they want opt-in actor resolution for tenant downloads. Thoughts?
jeff: Do we have per-export quotas? big exports could blow our SLOs.
sam: We do, but current quota is per-tenant streaming throughput. Need a separate job quota for 'audit exports'.
ana: (typo) ana: Security pointed out PII risk if actor mapping includes email. Can we pseudonymize and include a mapping file separately?
security-team: We prefer hashed actor id + optional mapping controlled by an admin. Also need KMS-protected signed links :lock:.
maria: UX idea: console toggle 'Include actor details' when creating export; if on, require admin consent and extra quota. If off, include actor hints ('team=payments', 'role=admin').
jeff: API shape proposal: `POST /v1/audit/exports` body: `{ "range": ..., "include_actor": true|false, "actor_resolution": "full|pseudonym|hints" }`
sam: Prefer `actor_resolution: 'none'|'hashed'|'resolve_to_alias'` to be explicit. Also return job id immediately, queue it.
audit-bot: Export job queued (job=exp_98765) — estimated time 2m for 50k events.
ana: (again) ana: What about telemetry? We need per-route cost in console and a warning before large exports.
jeff: We can surface estimated token count and a cost estimate in the modal. Console should block if estimated runtime > 30m unless admin override.
maria: Edge case: canary rollouts change policy history; export should include policy version id and rollout anchor. Also attach diff links.
security-team: :thumbsup: on version id. Also request audit trail includes 'authorization proof' when blob created.
sam: Implementation note: backend can stream NDJSON; header `X-Actor-Resolution: hashed` and sign the file. Prefer S3 presign flow with kms.
jeff: I'll sketch API changes and a console mock. @maria can you file a request with compliance for mapping retention rules?
maria: On it. Filing now. Also adding a short example response snippet:

`NDJSON sample (each line a JSON event)`
{"ts":"2026-03-20T15:00:00Z","event":"route.change","actor":"user:hash:d1e2f3a4","actor_hint":"team=payments;role=admin","policy_version":"pv_42","change":"added route X -> Y"}
{"ts":"2026-03-20T15:01:00Z","event":"route.canary","actor":"alias:alice","actor_hint":"role=dev","policy_version":"pv_43","change":"canary 10% rollout"}

jeff: Nice. Let's sync tomorrow 10am to finalize.
